title: Microsoft CEO Touts His Own DIY AI Project To Wall Street and His 20 Million Followers - Slashdot
excerpt: theodp writes: During Microsoft's 2026Q4 earnings call, CEO Microsoft Satya Nadella took time to tout a dashboard he personally created using AI from a Morgan Stanley analyst's PDF research report, which suggested a rosy payback for the so-called MAG7's ('Magnificent 7' companies) massive capital ex...
content_html:
theodp writes: During Microsoft's 2026Q4 earnings call, CEO Microsoft Satya Nadella took time to tout a dashboard he personally created using AI from a Morgan Stanley analyst's PDF research report, which suggested a rosy payback for the so-called MAG7's ('Magnificent 7' companies) massive capital expenditures on AI (to which Nadella later added a "not financial advice" disclaimer). "It would be fun for you, Adam. I think one of your colleagues put out an ROIC [Return on Invested Capital] document. I took that document to Copilot, which is a PDF, and I said, 'Build me a new Power BI dashboard, essentially.' But here is the thing. It built a rich semantic model that went into my Fabric with OneLake that brought all the data in from the external sources. In fact, it was current with all the SEC filings of all the MAG7. And then on top of that, the repo itself is in GitHub, but the artifact is sitting in my Copilot as a site. That, to me, is a classic example of an enterprise-wide workflow. I, as a knowledge worker, could go create a dashboard. The data engineer can go to Fabric and find the artifact. The professional developer can go to the repo and find it in GitHub. And by the way, it's all registered with Agent 365. That's a little bit of what Amy is describing as the coming together of a new way to work, even while at the same time, bringing IT, security and manageability of it."

After Nadella's show-and-tell drew an underwhelming response during the call ("That's very helpful. Thank you." said the Morgan Stanley analyst whose team's work Nadella scraped with AI), Nadella turned to social media with posts on LinkedIn (12M followers) and Twitter/X (8M followers) to make the case for why his DIY project was such a brilliant demonstration of how AI enables governance, controls, security, development, testing, deployment, maintenance, data analysis/modeling, visualization, usability, and value. "Some more detail on the ROIC Intelligence App I built yesterday and mentioned on today's earnings call," Nadella wrote on LinkedIn. "I took the PDF that Brian Nowak at Morgan Stanley put together for Hyperscale ROIC this week and used Copilot code (coming in our new superapp) with a single prompt + skill (/drill-me) to create the plan, then used autopilot in auto to create the full app (with history, lookups, scenarios, what-ifs, etc). And /rubber-duck to test. And the best part is that all the artifacts are in my enterprise environment. My app is in Copilot, my code is in GitHub Enterprise; all my data pipelines/lake/semantic models are in Fabric. And everything is under Agent 365 IT/Sec/FinOps control! So this is not about Tokenmaxxing or vibe coding. Every step of the way the rails are engineered to create value, making everything a long-term reusable asset, with governance/security, and cost controls. This is the full system to drive business value. Disclosures: This is all pulled from public sources, and for illustrative purposes only...not financial advice! :) Here is the app and architecture..."

Not unexpectedly, the accompanying screenshot of a splash page for the BI app and a buzzword-laden complicated architecture diagram drew universal praise from LinkedIn fans, but also a few barbs from less-than-impressed commenters on Nadella's Twitter/X post, some of whom suggested Nadella's project might even represent a jump-the-shark moment for AI mania. "That he doesn't see whats wrong with saying 'My app is in Copilot, my code is in GitHub Enterprise; all my data pipelines/lake/semantic models are in Fabric' is exactly why MS is failing at AI,'" replied @PassingPixels on X/Twitter. "Dude is having to run 5 different systems to emulate babies first vibe code." @zigmund_ignatov added, "Why do we call glorified slide show an app?" @Mathupiriyan quipped, "Looks like Copilot just turned a PDF into a profit crystal ball." Unimpressed, @Markusndnb remarked, "So you created a web page using tons of proprietary MS tools." And @FishyAccounting called on Nadella to show-his-work, saying "Post the prompt or it didn't happen." (btw, Microsoft President Brad Smith similarly declined to provide the prompt for his own self-described amazing AI DIY reporting project that he touted at Microsoft's Shareholder Meeting last December).

So, does Nadella's self-promoted AI reworking of someone else's PDF research report strike you as an amazing example of everything that's good about AI, or does it conjure up memories of The Emperor's New Clothes?

sentences.zh: 我认为你的一位同事发布了一份 ROIC [投资资本回报率] 文件。

sentences.zh: 我将该文档带到了 Copilot，这是一个 PDF 文件，我说：“本质上，为我构建一个新的 Power BI 仪表板。”

sentences.zh: 但事情是这样的。

sentences.zh: 它构建了一个丰富的语义模型，该模型进入我的 Fabric with OneLake，从外部源引入所有数据。

sentences.en: In fact, it was current with all the SEC filings of all the MAG7.
sentences.zh: 事实上，所有 MAG7 的所有 SEC 文件都是最新的。

sentences.en: And then on top of that, the repo itself is in GitHub, but the artifact is sitting in my Copilot as a site.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，存储库本身位于 GitHub 中，但工件作为站点位于我的 Copilot 中。

sentences.en: That, to me, is a classic example of an enterprise-wide workflow.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这是企业范围工作流程的典型示例。

sentences.en: I, as a knowledge worker, could go create a dashboard.

sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这一切都是在 Agent 365 中注册的。

sentences.en: That's a little bit of what Amy is describing as the coming together of a new way to work, even while at the same time, bringing IT, security and manageability of it."
sentences.zh: 这就是 Amy 所说的一种新的工作方式的融合，同时带来 IT、安全性和可管理性。”

sentences.en: After Nadella's show-and-tell drew an underwhelming response during the call ("That's very helpful.
sentences.zh: 纳德拉的展示和讲述在电话会议中引起了平淡的反应（“这非常有帮助。

sentences.en: Thank you."
sentences.zh: 谢谢。”

sentences.en: said the Morgan Stanley analyst whose team's work Nadella scraped with AI), Nadella turned to social media with posts on LinkedIn (12M followers) and Twitter/X (8M followers) to make the case for why his DIY project was such a brilliant demonstration of how AI enables governance, controls, security, development, testing, deployment, maintenance, data analysis/modeling, visualization, usability, and value.
sentences.zh: 摩根士丹利分析师表示，纳德拉的团队的工作与人工智能有关），纳德拉转向社交媒体，在 LinkedIn（1200 万关注者）和 Twitter/X（800 万关注者）上发帖，以说明为什么他的 DIY 项目如此出色地展示了人工智能如何实现治理、控制、安全、开发、测试、部署、维护、数据分析/建模、可视化、可用性和价值。

sentences.en: "Some more detail on the ROIC Intelligence App I built yesterday and mentioned on today's earnings call," Nadella wrote on LinkedIn.

sentences.en: And /rubber-duck to test.
sentences.zh: 和 /rubber-duck 进行测试。

sentences.zh: 最好的部分是所有工件都在我的企业环境中。

sentences.zh: 我的应用程序在 Copilot 中，我的代码在 GitHub Enterprise 中；我所有的数据管道/湖/语义模型都在 Fabric 中。

sentences.en: And everything is under Agent 365 IT/Sec/FinOps control!
sentences.zh: 一切都在 Agent 365 IT/Sec/FinOps 的控制之下！

sentences.en: So this is not about Tokenmaxxing or vibe coding.
sentences.zh: 所以这与 Tokenmaxxing 或 vivi 编码无关。

sentences.en: Every step of the way the rails are engineered to create value, making everything a long-term reusable asset, with governance/security, and cost controls.
sentences.zh: 轨道的每一步都旨在创造价值，使一切成为长期可重复使用的资产，并具有治理/安全性和成本控制。

sentences.en: This is the full system to drive business value.
sentences.zh: 这是驱动商业价值的完整系统。

sentences.en: Disclosures: This is all pulled from public sources, and for illustrative purposes only...not financial advice! :) Here is the app and architecture..."
sentences.zh: 披露：这全部来自公共来源，仅供说明之用……并非财务建议！ :) 这是应用程序和架构......”

sentences.zh: @FishyAccounting 呼吁纳德拉展示他的工作，并表示“发布提示，否则就不会发生。”

blocks.html_en: Not unexpectedly, the accompanying screenshot of a splash page for the BI app and a buzzword-laden complicated architecture diagram drew universal praise from LinkedIn fans, but also a few barbs from less-than-impressed commenters on Nadella's Twitter/X post, some of whom suggested Nadella's project might even represent a jump-the-shark moment for AI mania. "That he doesn't see whats wrong with saying 'My app is in Copilot, my code is in GitHub Enterprise; all my data pipelines/lake/semantic models are in Fabric' is exactly why MS is failing at AI,'" replied @PassingPixels on X/Twitter. "Dude is having to run 5 different systems to emulate babies first vibe code." @zigmund_ignatov added, "Why do we call glorified slide show an app?" @Mathupiriyan quipped, "Looks like Copilot just turned a PDF into a profit crystal ball." Unimpressed, @Markusndnb remarked, "So you created a web page using tons of proprietary MS tools." And @FishyAccounting called on Nadella to show-his-work, saying "Post the prompt or it didn't happen." (btw, Microsoft President Brad Smith similarly declined to provide the prompt for his own self-described amazing AI DIY reporting project that he touted at Microsoft's Shareholder Meeting last December).

content_html_zh: theodp 写道：在微软 2026 年第四季度财报电话会议上，微软首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉 (Satya Nadella) 花时间宣传了他亲自使用摩根士丹利分析师 PDF 研究报告中的人工智能创建的仪表板，该仪表板表明所谓的 MAG7（“Magnificent 7”公司）在人工智能上的巨额资本支出将得到乐观的回报（纳德拉后来在其中添加了“非财务建议”免责声明）。 “这对你来说会很有趣，亚当。 我认为你的一位同事发布了一份 ROIC [投资资本回报率] 文件。 我将该文档带到了 Copilot，这是一个 PDF 文件，我说：“本质上，为我构建一个新的 Power BI 仪表板。” 但事情是这样的。 它构建了一个丰富的语义模型，该模型进入我的 Fabric with OneLake，从外部源引入所有数据。 事实上，所有 MAG7 的所有 SEC 文件都是最新的。 最重要的是，存储库本身位于 GitHub 中，但工件作为站点位于我的 Copilot 中。 对我来说，这是企业范围工作流程的典型示例。 作为一名知识工作者，我可以创建一个仪表板。 数据工程师可以转到 Fabric 并找到工件。 专业开发人员可以前往该存储库并在 GitHub 中找到它。 顺便说一句，这一切都是在 Agent 365 中注册的。 这就是 Amy 所说的一种新的工作方式的融合，同时带来 IT、安全性和可管理性。” 纳德拉的展示和讲述在电话会议中引起了平淡的反应（“这非常有帮助。 谢谢。” 摩根士丹利分析师表示，纳德拉的团队的工作与人工智能有关），纳德拉转向社交媒体，在 LinkedIn（1200 万关注者）和 Twitter/X（800 万关注者）上发帖，以说明为什么他的 DIY 项目如此出色地展示了人工智能如何实现治理、控制、安全、开发、测试、部署、维护、数据分析/建模、可视化、可用性和价值。 纳德拉在 LinkedIn 上写道：“关于我昨天构建并在今天的财报电话会议上提到的 ROIC Intelligence 应用程序的更多细节。” “我拿了摩根士丹利的 Brian Nowak 本周为超大规模 ROIC 整理的 PDF，并使用 Copilot 代码（在我们新的超级应用程序中）和单个提示 + 技能 (/drill-me) 来创建计划，然后使用 auto 中的自动驾驶仪创建完整的应用程序（包含历史记录、查找、场景、假设等）。 和 /rubber-duck 进行测试。 最好的部分是所有工件都在我的企业环境中。 我的应用程序在 Copilot 中，我的代码在 GitHub Enterprise 中；我所有的数据管道/湖/语义模型都在 Fabric 中。 一切都在 Agent 365 IT/Sec/FinOps 的控制之下！ 所以这与 Tokenmaxxing 或 vivi 编码无关。 轨道的每一步都旨在创造价值，使一切成为长期可重复使用的资产，并具有治理/安全性和成本控制。 这是驱动商业价值的完整系统。 披露：这全部来自公共来源，仅供说明之用……并非财务建议！ :) 这是应用程序和架构......” 不出所料，BI 应用程序的初始页面截图和充满流行语的复杂架构图引起了 LinkedIn 粉丝的普遍赞誉，但纳德拉的 Twitter/X 帖子上的评论者也提出了一些不那么令人印象深刻的倒刺，其中一些人认为纳德拉的项目甚至可能代表了人工智能狂热的跳跃时刻。 “他不明白‘我的应用程序在 Copilot 中，我的代码在 GitHub Enterprise 中；我所有的数据管道/湖/语义模型都在 Fabric 中’这句话有什么问题，这正是微软在人工智能方面失败的原因，”@PassingPixels 在 X/Twitter 上回复道。 “这家伙必须运行 5 个不同的系统来模拟婴儿第一振动代码。” @zigmund_ignatov 补充道，“为什么我们称美化的幻灯片为应用程序？” @Mathupiriyan 打趣道：“看起来 Copilot 刚刚将 PDF 变成了利润水晶球。” @Markusndnb 不为所动地评论道：“所以你使用了大量专有的 MS 工具创建了一个网页。” @FishyAccounting 呼吁纳德拉展示他的工作，并表示“发布提示，否则就不会发生。” （顺便说一句，微软总裁布拉德·史密斯（Brad Smith）同样拒绝为他自己描述的令人惊叹的人工智能 DIY 报告项目提供提示，他在去年 12 月的微软股东大会上宣传了该项目。 那么，纳德拉自吹自擂的人工智能对别人的 PDF 研究报告的重写是否让你觉得这是人工智能所有优点的一个惊人例子，或者它是否让人想起皇帝的新装？
